robustness.name: Sampled lobe separations retain C1 seam continuity and zero far-field bloat

good_fit: Organic metaballs, clay sculpting, droplets, and character joint fillets in SDF raymarching
Preserving exact primitive dimensions outside the blend band (|a - b| >= k)
Computing C1 surface normals analytically without 4-tap or 6-tap finite differences
Explaining why hard min(d_A, d_B) causes specular highlight snapping across seams
not_for: Neural SDF Eikonal MLP training or closest-point neural CSG regularizers
Mechanical CAD chamfers requiring flat 45-degree bevel planes
G2 curvature-continuous Class-A automotive surfacing (requires cubic/quartic smin)
Polygon mesh Boolean clipping (Sutherland-Hodgman / BSP trees)
